source_review.notes: Checked seven official or primary sources. Current OpenAPI 3.2.0 defines machine-readable HTTP interface descriptions and contact metadata but not organizational accountability. Google Cloud publishes an API design guide aligned with AIPs. The current GOV.UK Service Standard emphasizes understanding users, multidisciplinary teams, defining success/publishing performance, and reliable operation. Google SRE frames SLOs around service behavior that matters to users. RFC 9110 supplies HTTP semantics. RFC 9745 defines HTTP deprecation signaling to consumers without replacing direct communication or changing behavior. W3C Trace Context defines correlation plus privacy/security considerations, not consumer identity. Local product roles and governance are not attributed as universal standards.

pedagogical_review.notes: The module expands ownership from code/backlog to capability, consumers, multidisciplinary authority, service offer, live operation, economics, measurement, evolution, succession, and exit. Counterexamples challenge traffic, availability, registrations, ticket, and provider-cost shortcuts. Ten examples and five integrative exercises have complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, product, legal, security, reliability, finance, or practitioner review is claimed.
